reuse.why: It adds one assertAccountNotLinked helper to accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank and has all five link handlers call it; the tree has no shared linking function to put it in.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; the only repetition is the five near-identical call statements forced by the tree's copied link handlers.

placement.why: accounts/link.ts already holds the shared linking helpers, and each handler calls the guard before findOrCreateBank, so nothing is created before the refusal.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and unit tests for it are added.

maintainability.why: Clear, tested and named; because the handlers remain separate copies, a future provider must remember to call the guard.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers call link.assertAccountNotLinked; none re-implements the query.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the per-handler lines are calls to the shared helper, not copies of its logic.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking link handlers.
